claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Taygetean concepts have no direct equivalent to human gravity; instead, she describes consciousness flowing through ether as forming matter and sustaining stellar orbits, while terrestrial gravity equations capture only limited interactions.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She rejects gravity as conceived by Earth science but acknowledges its equations as valid within a limited scope.

review_flags: The source advances metaphysical claims that reject conventional gravity while elsewhere granting limited validity to terrestrial gravity equations.
coverage_gaps: The monologue also discusses the relative nature of truth and perception and criticizes Earth's base-10 physical models.
